_note: DAX Lib (daxlib.org) packages this kit may install, through the daxlib-mcp server (.mcp.json, pinned to @daxlib/mcp@0.1.0). Order of preference for a function: a package listed here, then new DAX. /plan puts a package a rep needs on the model approval list; /model approved installs it with daxlib-mcp install_package and records it under `installed`. Licences checked 2026-10-24 (VERSIONS.md, docs/it-security.md). A package not listed here needs its licence checked and a row here first. Each package is also vendored (design/udf/vendor/, `vendored`: source commit, licence file, SHA-256 of functions.tmdl) for a laptop where npm is blocked: design/udf/vendored.py turns it into modeling MCP function definitions.

server.name: daxlib-mcp
server.licenceSource: npm registry (npm view @daxlib/mcp license) and https://github.com/daxlib/daxlib-mcp
server.requires: Power BI Desktop on Windows x64, a model at compatibility level 1702 or later (install_package refuses below it and never raises it: /model raises it as its own approval item), Node.js 18+ (npx)
server.tested: 2026-10-24 on a scratch copy of Rep 10 (pbik-daxlib-test): level raised 1606 -> 1702 with the modeling MCP, DaxLib.SVG 2.0.0 installed (58 functions), saved by Desktop to definition/functions.tmdl; pbik model check counts the 58 functions

packages.authors: Kurt Buhler, Jake Duddy, Tom Shanley
packages.use: SVG measures (ladder step 2): sparklines, bars, dumbbells and other table or card images, before writing SVG by hand
packages.note: Pass colours as raw #RRGGBB, never %23: its output keeps a raw % (width='100%'), so Power BI does not decode the URI; raw # renders and %23 draws nothing (checked in Desktop on card and table images, 2026-10-24, v0.4.1). pbik validate flags a %23 argument

packages.licenceSource: no repository of its own: it lives in https://github.com/daxlib/daxlib (LICENSE: MIT, Copyright (c) 2025 SQLBI)
packages.use: WCAG contrast of measure-driven colours (CLAUDE.md Accessibility): text colour measures checked against their background

packages.licenceSource: no repository of its own: it lives in https://github.com/daxlib/daxlib (LICENSE: MIT, Copyright (c) 2025 SQLBI)
packages.use: exception rules (docs/patterns/exception-list.md): z-score, IQR and other outlier tests
